format: MHP3rd Companion 1.1 skill review final decisions

basis.policy: All audit candidates marked OK are accepted unless overridden below. Preserve stable skill-tree IDs and Team Maverick ONE naming.

categoryOverrides.name: Anti-Theft
categoryOverrides.reason: Player review judged theft prevention to be utility rather than defense.

mandatoryAuditCorrections.name: Stun
mandatoryAuditCorrections.treeShort: Changes resistance to being stunned: +15 prevents stun, +10 halves stun chance, and -10 doubles stun chance.
mandatoryAuditCorrections.note: Replace the old tree wording about halving/doubling stun duration.

reviewOverrides.name: Anti-Theft
reviewOverrides.treeShort: Prevents items from being stolen, including by Melynx.
reviewOverrides.treeDetailed: Prevents items from being stolen. Melynx are the black Felyne-like enemies that commonly steal items.

reviewOverrides.name: Auto-Guard
reviewOverrides.treeShort: Automatically guards guardable attacks while your weapon is drawn, if the equipped weapon can guard.
reviewOverrides.treeDetailed: Automatically guards when the equipped weapon is capable of guarding, the incoming attack can be guarded, and Auto-Guard can trigger in the current state.

reviewOverrides.name: Bomb Boost
reviewOverrides.treeShort: Boosts bomb damage and makes bomb-item combinations succeed 100%.

activationOverrides.Bombardier: Damaging bomb items deal 1.3× damage, and bomb-item combination recipes succeed 100%. For Polytan Bomb, only the physical damage portion is boosted.

reviewOverrides.name: Capture
reviewOverrides.treeShort: Increases the number of capture reward slots.

activationOverrides.Capture Master: Capture reward slots increase from the normal 2–3 to 3–4.
activationOverrides.Capture Expert: Capture reward slots become 3 instead of the normal 2–3.

reviewOverrides.name: Combo Rate
reviewOverrides.activationWordingRule: Use 'Item combination success rate' instead of bare 'combination success rate' for every threshold.

reviewOverrides.name: Constitution
reviewOverrides.treeShort: Changes fixed stamina costs for evading, guarding, and some weapon actions.

activationOverrides.Constitution +2: Fixed stamina costs for evades, guarding, and Switch Axe swings are reduced to 1/2.
activationOverrides.Constitution +1: Fixed stamina costs for evades, guarding, and Switch Axe swings are reduced to 3/4.
activationOverrides.Constitution -1: Fixed stamina costs for evades, guarding, and Switch Axe swings increase.
activationOverrides.Constitution -2: Fixed stamina costs for evades, guarding, and Switch Axe swings increase substantially.

reviewOverrides.note: Do not show source/audit meta-text such as 'do not quantify without a source' to end users.

reviewOverrides.name: Fate
reviewOverrides.treeShort: Changes how likely the game is to add additional basic quest reward slots. It does not improve the contents of a reward slot or a specific item's drop rate.

activationOverrides.Great Luck: Raises the chance of receiving each next basic reward slot from 22/32 to 29/32.
activationOverrides.Good Luck: Raises the chance of receiving each next basic reward slot from 22/32 to 26/32.
activationOverrides.Bad Luck: Lowers the chance of receiving each next basic reward slot from 22/32 to 16/32.
activationOverrides.Horrible Luck: Lowers the chance of receiving each next basic reward slot from 22/32 to 8/32.

reviewOverrides.name: Gloves Off
reviewOverrides.treeShort: Temporarily boosts Affinity and reduces stamina use after fighting a large monster long enough or taking enough damage.

activationOverrides.Latent Power +1: Activates for 90 seconds after about 5 minutes while detected by a large monster or after accumulating about 150 damage. Grants +30% Affinity and halves stamina consumption. It can activate again after the effect ends.
activationOverrides.Latent Power +2: Activates for 90 seconds after about 5 minutes while detected by a large monster or after accumulating about 150 damage. Grants +50% Affinity, reduces continuous stamina drain to 1/4, and greatly reduces fixed stamina costs. It can activate again after the effect ends.

reviewOverrides.note: Do not publish an exact Latent Power +2 fixed-cost multiplier in 1.1: MHP3 sources conflict between a generic 1/4 statement and weapon-specific/tested 1/5 fixed-cost behavior.

reviewOverrides.name: Guard
reviewOverrides.treeShort: Changes knockback and chip damage received while guarding. (Blademaster only)
reviewOverrides.activationWordingRule: Use 'knockback and chip damage received while guarding' rather than ambiguous 'damage'.

activationOverrides.Guard +2: Guarding greatly reduces knockback and chip damage received while guarding.
activationOverrides.Guard +1: Guarding reduces knockback and chip damage received while guarding.
activationOverrides.Guard -1: Guarding increases knockback and chip damage received while guarding.

reviewOverrides.name: KO
reviewOverrides.treeShort: Increases KO (stun) buildup. KO is mainly built by hitting a monster's head; reaching its threshold briefly stuns the monster.

activationOverrides.Knockout King: KO (stun) buildup is 1.1×, rounded down at the first decimal.

reviewOverrides.name: Punishing Draw
reviewOverrides.treeShort: Adds KO (stun) and exhaust buildup to draw attacks with cutting weapons. (Blademaster only)
reviewOverrides.treeDetailed: Draw attacks with cutting weapons gain stun and exhaust buildup. KO/stun buildup is normally applied by hitting the monster's head; reaching the stun threshold briefly stuns it. For weapons other than Dual Blades, the added stun value is 30.

reviewOverrides.name: Status
reviewOverrides.treeShort: Changes poison, paralysis, and sleep buildup.

activationOverrides.Status Atk +2: Poison, paralysis, and sleep buildup is 1.2× + 1. For Blademaster weapons, the status value shown in the equipment screen is only an approximation; the internal calculation keeps the fractional value.
activationOverrides.Status Atk +1: Poison, paralysis, and sleep buildup is 1.1× + 1. For Blademaster weapons, the status value shown in the equipment screen is only an approximation; the internal calculation keeps the fractional value.
activationOverrides.Status Atk Down: Poison, paralysis, and sleep buildup is 0.9×. For Blademaster weapons, the displayed status value is approximate. This reduction also makes capture tranquilizer buildup weak enough that 3 Tranq Bombs are required.

implementationRules: Use OR semantics for category filters.
All four categories selected must behave the same as no category filter.
Do not expose audit/source-confidence language in player-facing descriptions unless it is intentionally part of the final copy.
Do not invent exact multipliers where the audit left evidence unresolved.
Retain all user-accepted audit candidates for skills not overridden here.
